thread:
maya_cs: Heads up — NovaCart's staging is getting 429s during onboarding after they enabled the SDK prefetch pipeline. Posting timeline + sample logs. Can someone triage quick?

raj_eng: Can you paste the root request id + sample request headers? My first guess is connection churn/HTTP2 streams hitting a proxy limit. Seen this with some edge proxies.

maya_cs: Root request id: nc-stg-2026-03-22-1. Excerpt from staging logs:
```
[2026-03-22T16:03:11Z] req=nc-stg-2026-03-22-1 path=/v1/predict status=429 upstream=nginx edge=cloud-proxy x-rq-id=nc-abc123 reason=rate_limit
[2026-03-22T16:03:11Z] header: :method=POST, :authority=api.redwood.test, connection=keep-alive, x-client=novacart-web
[2026-03-22T16:03:11Z] concurrent_preflight=12 prefetch=true
```
They do an immediate fanout of prefetch requests from the client on cold start.

olivia_se: Thanks — that pattern is classic client-side fanout + no splay. Quick mitigations: lower SDK prefetch concurrency and add jitter/splay. Also make sure client reuses connections (keep-alive) instead of spawning short-lived connections. Example for their JS SDK: 
```js
SDK.init({
  prefetch: { enabled: true, concurrency: 2, splay_ms: 250 }
});
// and add an onboarding header so ops can short-circuit counting
fetch(url, { headers: { 'X-Onboard-Namespace': 'novacart_stg' } });
```

raj_eng: Also recommend increasing client-side token cache TTL and avoid re-fetching tokens on each worker start. On the infra side we can add a temporary per-tenant soft exemption for preflight traffic while they onboard, but ops wants a clear expiry + rollback. @maya_cs do we want to propose that?

maya_cs: We should — NovaCart is on a promo and delays hurt renewal momentum. If we offer a short exemption window, we need a scheduled rollback and monitoring. Can we make it a canary rule (apply to staging namespace only, auto-expire)?

olivia_se: Yes. We can implement a per-tenant rule: exclude requests with header X-Onboard-Namespace: novacart_stg from hard throttling for 30 minutes. Ops will want evidence it reduced the spike. I'll draft the rule text.

maya_cs: I'll request the header + client config change from them and schedule a 20m call. Proposed time: tomorrow 10:30am PT. Also capturing feedback: they said the SDK default prefetch behavior was 'surprising' and doc steps weren't obvious — we should patch docs after.

cam_novacart: We can add the header now and adjust concurrency. Can you send the exact snippet? Would prefer to test in staging later today.

olivia_se: Pasting minimal patch to their client: 
```js
// add header to preflight/probe requests
const hdrs = { 'X-Onboard-Namespace': 'novacart_stg', 'User-Agent': 'NovaCart/1.0' }
fetch('/_internal/prefetch', { method: 'POST', headers: hdrs, body: JSON.stringify(payload) });
```
Docs: https://redwood.dev/docs/clients/prefetch (I'll open a docs PR after this thread)

maya_cs: Plan to execute / test:
1) add header + set prefetch.concurrency=2 + splay 250ms
2) restart staging clients
3) observe for >=5m without 429 surge
4) ops adds temporary exemption for 30m
5) rollback exemption after confirmed stable
I'll update the SRE ticket with timestamps and results.

raj_eng: Filing the temporary rule now and will post the rule id here when created.

cam_novacart: We're ready to try in ~20m from now. Thanks all!

maya_cs: Great — I'll run the call and capture notes + follow-up doc changes. @olivia_se I'll need the PR link once you open it. :thumbsup:
